title: panel.scan.requested payload (v1)
description: Payload of the panel.scan.requested outbox event. Producer: app/watcher/registry.py::_emit_watch_event (vault_path, relative_path, mtime, hash, watcher). Consumer: app/workers/outbox_worker.py::handle_panel_scan_requested, which resolves the note via _note_path_from_payload (vault_path preferred, relative_path fallback). Requires at least one of vault_path or relative_path so the consumer can resolve a note path.
